elsewhere.note: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.
When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.
For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea…
